UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR041 Seawater Cooling Low Supply Alarm

UML:TaggedValue.value: [Source requirement] For the seawater cooling system, if a main circulation pump-related configuration is adopted, a low supply condition must be able to trigger an alarm to facilitate timely startup or switching.

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR041.1 Low Supply Alarm Display Requirement

UML:TaggedValue.value: When the seawater cooling system is configured with a main circulation pump, a low supply alarm function shall be provided. The alarm signal shall be capable of being displayed on the bridge or at the main control station so that operators can promptly start the standby pump or switch to the standby pump. Criterion: {{TBD|unit:MPa|ref:S43 ABS Marine Vessel Rules Part 4 2021|component:Seawater cooling system main circulation pump|intent:Low supply alarm threshold|hint:The alarm threshold shall be determined based on the manufacturer's technical data or project calculation documents and shall not exceed the scope of the specific manufacturer, engine model, and control system configuration}} Grade: C Derivation: Deferred Route: OPEN_ITEM --- value deferred to named source document Verification: Test Cited: E-HT-ALARM-001; E-PUMP-ALARM-002

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR041.2 Cooling Water Pump Redundancy Requiremen

UML:TaggedValue.value: The seawater cooling system shall be provided with at least two cooling water pumps, one of which shall be a standby pump. The capacity of the standby pump shall not be less than that of the main pump, and at least one pump shall be driven by an independent drive unit. Criterion: {{TBD|unit:unit|ref:S44 PRS Ship Machinery Piping Systems|component:Seawater cooling water pump|intent:Pump quantity and standby pump capacity|hint:At least two pumps, one of which is a standby pump; standby pump capacity not less than main pump capacity; at least one pump independently driven}} Grade: C Derivation: Deferred Route: OPEN_ITEM --- value deferred to named source document Verification: Inspect Cited: E-PUMP-RED-004; E-PUMP-RED-002

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR041.3 Standby Pump Activation After Alarm

UML:TaggedValue.value: When the seawater cooling system low supply alarm is triggered, the standby pump shall be capable of being started automatically or manually, or switching to the standby pump shall be possible, to restore the cooling water supply. Criterion: {{TBD|unit:s|ref:S28 Wärtsilä 32 Product Guide, Cooling Water System|component:Seawater cooling system main circulation pump|intent:Standby pump startup or switching response time|hint:The response time shall be determined based on the manufacturer's technical data or project calculation documents and shall not exceed the scope of the specific manufacturer, engine model, and control system configuration}} Grade: C Derivation: Deferred Route: OPEN_ITEM --- value deferred to named source document Verification: Test Cited: E-COOLER-CTRL-001; E-PUMP-TEMP-003

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR041.4 Independent Low Supply Alarm Sensor

UML:TaggedValue.value: The sensor for the seawater cooling system low supply alarm shall be independently arranged and shall be capable of continuously monitoring the seawater cooling water supply pressure or flow. The alarm signal shall be transmitted to the engine control system or alarm monitoring system. Criterion: {{TBD|unit:MPa|ref:S21 Caterpillar Cooling Systems Application and Installation Guide|component:Seawater cooling water pressure switch|intent:Low supply alarm trigger pressure|hint:The alarm trigger pressure shall be determined based on the manufacturer's technical data or project calculation documents and shall not exceed the scope of the specific manufacturer, engine model, and control system configuration}} Grade: C Derivation: Deferred Route: OPEN_ITEM --- value deferred to named source document Verification: Inspect Cited: E-PUMP-ALARM-002; E-COOLER- CTRL-001

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR041.5 Alarm Threshold Configuration Limitation

UML:TaggedValue.value: The threshold and action logic of the seawater cooling system low supply alarm shall be strictly limited to the scope of the corresponding manufacturer, engine model, and control system configuration, and shall not be generalized beyond that scope. Criterion: {{TBD|unit:MPa|ref:S43 ABS Marine Vessel Rules Part 4 2021|component:Seawater cooling system main circulation pump|intent:Low supply alarm threshold|hint:The alarm threshold shall be determined based on the manufacturer's technical data or project calculation documents and shall not exceed the scope of the specific manufacturer, engine model, and control system configuration}} Grade: C Derivation: Deferred Route: OPEN_ITEM --- value deferred to named source document Verification: Analyze Cited: E-HT-ALARM-001; E-PUMP-ALARM-002

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR052 Cooling Pump Maintenance Access Space

UML:TaggedValue.value: [Source requirement] Space must be provided for maintenance of the cooling water pump seals, bearings, and motor; it must not be necessary to move many pipes just to remove a small component.

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR052.1 Direct Removal of Pump Components

UML:TaggedValue.value: The seals, bearings, and motor of the cooling water pump shall be arranged so that they can be directly removed and installed without first moving unrelated piping or other equipment. Criterion: {{TBD|unit:mm|ref:S21 Caterpillar Cooling Systems Application and Installation Guide|component:Cooling water pump|intent:Maintenance space|hint:The minimum clearance dimensions required for removal of seals, bearings, and motor shall be specified}} Grade: C Derivation: Deferred Route: OPEN_ITEM --- value deferred to named source document Verification: Inspect Cited: E-PUMP-MAINT-001

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR052.2 Adequate Maintenance Space Around Pump

UML:TaggedValue.value: Sufficient maintenance space shall be provided around the cooling water pump to facilitate removal and installation of the seals, bearings, and motor. Criterion: {{TBD|unit:mm|ref:S21 Caterpillar Cooling Systems Application and Installation Guide|component:Cooling water pump|intent:Maintenance space|hint:The minimum space dimensions required for maintenance operations shall be specified}} Grade: C Derivation: Deferred Route: OPEN_ITEM --- value deferred to named source document Verification: Inspect Cited: E-PUMP-MAINT-001

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR052.3 Accessible Pump Piping Arrangement

UML:TaggedValue.value: The piping arrangement of the cooling water pump shall allow convenient access to the pump seals, bearings, and motor, and removal of these components shall not require moving a large amount of piping. Criterion: {{TBD|unit:mm|ref:S51 NASA NTRS 19800002357 Piping Specification|component:Cooling water pump piping|intent:Maintenance accessibility|hint:The access passage or space dimensions to be provided by the piping arrangement shall be specified}} Grade: C Derivation: Deferred Route: OPEN_ITEM --- value deferred to named source document Verification: Inspect Cited: E-COOLER-MAINT-01 9

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR052.4 Manufacturer Maintenance Space Complianc

UML:TaggedValue.value: The maintenance space for the cooling water pump seals, bearings, and motor shall meet the manufacturer's specified maintenance operation requirements, ensuring that maintenance can be performed without removing unrelated piping. Criterion: {{TBD|unit:mm|ref:S21 Caterpillar Cooling Systems Application and Installation Guide|component:Cooling water pump|intent:Maintenance space|hint:The manufacturer- specified maintenance space dimensions shall be specified}} Grade: C Derivation: Deferred Route: OPEN_ITEM --- value deferred to named source document Verification: Inspect Cited: E-PUMP-MAINT-001

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008 Temperature Control Valve Verification

UML:TaggedValue.value: [Source requirement] The setpoint and installation position of the temperature control valve must be checked against the main engine requirements; otherwise, the water temperature may not be controlled within the appropriate range.

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.1 High Temperature Cooling Valve Setting

UML:TaggedValue.value: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The high-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature setpoint shall be 79°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 77-85°C. Criterion: 79°C nominal; mechanical thermostatic element range 77-85°C Grade: B Derivation: Direct Route: ENGINEER_CONFIRM --- cites manufacturer/operational guidance only (tier-b) Verification: Inspect Cited: E-LT-COMP-006

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.2 Low Temperature Cooling Valve Setting

UML:TaggedValue.value: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The low-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature setpoint shall be 35°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 29-41°C. Criterion: 35°C nominal; mechanical thermostatic element range 29-41°C Grade: B Derivation: Direct Route: ENGINEER_CONFIRM --- cites manufacturer/operational guidance only (tier-b) Verification: Inspect Cited: E-LT-COMP-006

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.3 Lubricating Oil Temperature Valve Settin

UML:TaggedValue.value: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The lubricating oil inlet temperature setpoint shall be 66°C nominal, and the mechanical thermostatic element adjustment range shall be 63-72°C. Criterion: 66°C nominal; mechanical thermostatic element range 63-72°C Grade: B Derivation: Direct Route: ENGINEER_CONFIRM --- cites manufacturer/operational guidance only (tier-b) Verification: Inspect Cited: E-LT-COMP-006

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.4 Three Way Valve Installation Position

UML:TaggedValue.value: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. The three-way valve shall be installed as a mixing valve, and its design pressure loss shall be 0.3-0.6 bar. Criterion: 0.3-0.6 bar Grade: B Derivation: Direct Route: ENGINEER_CONFIRM --- cites manufacturer/operational guidance only (tier-b) Verification: Inspect Cited: E-TCV-TEMP-047

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.5 Temperature Sensor Piping Length

UML:TaggedValue.value: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. The pipe length between the temperature sensor installation position and the three-way valve shall be maintained at 10 to 15 times the pipe diameter. Criterion: 10 to 15 times the pipe diameter Grade: C Derivation: Direct Route: ENGINEER_CONFIRM --- cites manufacturer/operational guidance only (tier-b) Verification: Inspect Cited: E-TCV-TEMP-047

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.6 High Temperature Cooling Control Range

UML:TaggedValue.value: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The high-temperature cooling water engine outlet temperature shall be controlled between 90 and 100°C, and the electronic water temperature controller shall identify deviations via the engine outlet sensor and correct the reference value. Criterion: 90-100°C Grade: B Derivation: Direct Route: ENGINEER_CONFIRM --- cites manufacturer/operational guidance only (tier-b) Verification: Inspect Cited: E-SYS-COMP-006

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.7 External Controller for Shared System

UML:TaggedValue.value: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. When multiple engines share a combined low-temperature cooling water system, an external temperature controller shall be used. The external controller shall be installed at the engine control room console and wired to the temperature control valve. Criterion: {{TBD|unit:none|ref:S41 Everllence 49/60DF Project Guide|component:Low-temperature cooling water temperature control valve|intent:Installation position|hint:External temperature controller installed at the engine control room console and wired to the temperature control valve}} Grade: C Derivation: Deferred Route: OPEN_ITEM --- value deferred to named source document Verification: Inspect Cited: E-TCV-TEMP-055

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.8 Common Low Temperature Control Valve

UML:TaggedValue.value: The installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's requirements. When engine-driven low-temperature pumps are used to cool external equipment, a common low- temperature temperature control valve shall be provided in the external system. The common low- temperature temperature control valve shall be installed after the central cooler and shall control the water temperature before the engine and external equipment by partially bypassing the central cooler. Criterion: {{TBD|unit:none|ref:S28 Wärtsilä 32 Product Guide, Cooling Water System|component:Common low- temperature temperature control valve|intent:Installation position|hint:Common low- temperature temperature control valve installed after the central cooler, controlling water temperature before the engine and external equipment by partially bypassing the central cooler}} Grade: C Derivation: Deferred Route: OPEN_ITEM --- value deferred to named source document Verification: Inspect Cited: E-TCV-TEMP-062

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.9 Auxiliary Engine Outlet Temperature Sett

UML:TaggedValue.value: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The auxiliary engine outlet temperature shall be maintained constant at approximately 80°C. Criterion: 80°C Grade: B Derivation: Direct Route: ENGINEER_CONFIRM --- cites manufacturer/operational guidance only (tier-b) Verification: Inspect Cited: E-LT-PRESS-003; E-LT-PRESS-005

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.10 Auxiliary Engine Outlet Temperature Sett

UML:TaggedValue.value: The setpoint of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data. The auxiliary engine outlet temperature shall be maintained constant at approximately 80°C. Criterion: 80°C Grade: B Derivation: Direct Route: ENGINEER_CONFIRM --- cites manufacturer/operational guidance only (tier-b) Verification: Inspect Cited: E-HT-COMP-004

UML:ClassifierRole.name: OR008.11 Valve Setting and Location Verification

UML:TaggedValue.value: The setpoint and installation position of the temperature control valve shall be checked against the main engine manufacturer's technical data or project calculation documents. The parameter confirmation path shall follow the minimum temperature control method of the cooling system thermostatic control (inlet control or outlet control), and the maximum temperature shall be controlled by correct sizing of the radiator, heat exchanger, or similar equipment. Criterion: {{TBD|unit:none|ref:S21 Caterpillar Cooling Systems Application and Installation Guide|component:Temperature control valve|intent:Setpoint and installation position confirmation path|hint:Determined based on the main engine manufacturer's technical data or project calculation documents, distinguishing between inlet control and outlet control methods}} Grade: C Derivation: Deferred Route: OPEN_ITEM --- value deferred to named source document Verification: Analyze Cited: E-SYS-PRESS-006
